notes:
Inbound from fintech startup building payments orchestration + customer support chatbot. Source: email signup -> product tour -> requested SOC2. Very product-led — CEO signed up developers first week. AE intro 2026-03-02. Short bullets from call:
- Wants hosted API to start (self-serve), likely graduate to Dedicated/VPC in 12-18 months if growth requires it.
- "We need SOC2 paperwork before legal signs off" (procurement).
- SSO is required for admin console access; engineers will use API keys for POC.
- Primary workloads: customer support chat (low-latency), doc search over transaction logs (embeddings), lightweight reranking for fraud signals in real-time streams.
- Latency targets: p95 chat < 400ms; burst throughput ~50-150 rps initial.
- Cost sensitivity: early-stage budget; evaluating cost per 1M tokens. Wants simple cost controls and per-route breakdowns.
- Security: data residency preference US, audit logs mandatory, KMS later. No legal push for air-gapped.
- SE asked for sample canary rollout plan + rollback + token-cost estimator.
- Asked about model options (open models first) and fallback to smaller quantized variants for spikes.
- Mentioned competitors: "we've tested OpenAI via sandbox; curious about cost delta and latency tradeoffs."
- Quote: "If we can keep costs predictable and have SOC2 docs, we can move to a paid plan in weeks."
- Next: send SOC2 summary + SSO quickstart + hosted pricing band examples. Book SE tech Q&A (30m) week of 2026-03-15.
timeline: 2026-02-19: inbound signup (developer). 2026-02-21: API trial started. 2026-03-02: AE intro call (Jordan) + SE joined. 2026-03-03: sent baseline pricing link and product FAQ. 2026-03-05: RedPeak legal requested SOC2 artifact. 2026-03-09: follow-up email with SSO questions; RedPeak asks for drive docs. 2026-03-10: Fireflies call recorded (ff_20260302_0842_call_redpeak).
technical_requirements: Primary: hosted API with streaming responses for chat; token-level cost breakdown; per-route latency dashboards; SSO for web console; audit logs retained 90 days; US data residency. Secondary: optional VPC/Dedicated interest in 12-18 months, KMS/HSM integration later.
poc_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): self-serve sign-up + sample integration (chat + embeddings). Phase 2 (2-4 weeks): end-to-end demo with sample dataset, measure latency and cost. Success criteria: <p95 400ms chat, embeddings recall > 85% on test set, cost within forecast range. If green, discuss monthly committed Dedicated options.
notes_short: SMB fintech inbound; SOC2 + SSO early asks; hosted start; VPC-curious later; budget conscious. SE call next week.
additional_context: Team: 2 backend eng, 1 ML engineer, 1 ops. Product roadmap includes omnichannel support (chat + email) and fraud signal enrichment. Using Postgres + S3; plan to pipeline transactions to embeddings for search.
